environment: Windows Sandbox with networking enabled, run as SYSTEM, Edge confirmed by the operator
scope: F2 slice 4b: block log uploaded by the agent with its category, and the category name on the block page, on top of the slice 4a category checks

package.build: tools/build-msi-fixtures.ps1 -Production (no defines), WiX 5.0.2, version 0.3.0, agent and installer source at 260766a
package.fault_injection_actions: absent (CustomAction table checked inside Sandbox before install)

categories.build: app/categories.py build_categories from a two-domain UT1-shaped games list (steampowered.com, steamcommunity.com)

checks: production install downloads the games category and blocks it through system DNS
allowed exception and unlisted names resolve upstream
blocked answers reach the server block log with their category
the category is cached in the protected data directory with its published digest
with the backend offline, a service restart keeps blocking from the cache
Edge shows the block page naming the Jogos category for steamcommunity.com, confirmed by the operator
removal restores NRPT rules, trust and hosts
operator_observation: Edge showed the RSM block page for https://steamcommunity.com/ with "Categoria: Jogos" and no certificate warning
notes: The simulated backend recorded the agent's uploads; the check required an hourly row for api.steampowered.com with reason category and category games, and no row for the allowed store.steampowered.com or the unlisted example.org
The simulated backend does not implement the server's validation and retention; those are covered by tests/test_block_events.py against the real application
not_validated: Real management server, PostgreSQL migration 002_block_events.sql and the panel against real data
Docker image build and the opt-in compose categories job with a real UT1 download
UT1 license confirmation at the official source
LGPD review of the block log by the RSM legal team or DPO before production
